ban_patterns.description: Raw hex color values should use design tokens
ban_patterns.message: Use design token instead of raw hex color: {match}. Define colors in your token config.

ban_patterns.description: Raw RGB/RGBA color values should use design tokens
ban_patterns.message: Use design token instead of raw RGB color: {match}. Define colors in your token config.

ban_patterns.description: Arbitrary pixel values for spacing should use spacing scale
ban_patterns.message: Use spacing token instead of arbitrary px value: {match}. Use values from spacing scale.

ban_patterns.description: Arbitrary pixel values for border-radius should use radius scale
ban_patterns.message: Use radius token instead of arbitrary px value: {match}. Use values from radius scale.

ban_patterns.description: Arbitrary pixel values for font-size should use font size scale
ban_patterns.message: Use font size token instead of arbitrary px value: {match}. Use values from font size scale.

ban_patterns.description: Magic numbers in box-shadow should use shadow tokens
ban_patterns.message: Use shadow token instead of raw box-shadow values: {match}. Use values from shadow scale.

ban_patterns.description: CSS variables with color values should reference token variables
ban_patterns.message: CSS variable uses raw hex color: {match}. Reference a design token variable instead.

ban_patterns.description: Hardcoded z-index values should use a defined scale
ban_patterns.message: Use z-index token instead of magic number: {match}. Define z-index scale in config.

ban_patterns.description: Viewport units for sizing should be avoided in favor of container-relative units
ban_patterns.message: Avoid viewport units: {match}. Use container-relative or token-based sizing.
Avoid !important: {match}. Restructure CSS to avoid specificity conflicts.
